entries.name: Chakra Protection
entries.text: Select two damage types. Gain resistance to the selected damage types. If you have vulnerability to a chosen damage type as the result of a different trait, you cannot gain resistance to that chosen damage type.

entries.name: Corrosive Aura
entries.text: Once per turn, when you cast a Futton Clan Hijutsu, all creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution save against your Ninjutsu save DC. On a failed save, they gain the corroded condition.

entries.name: Expert Elementalist
entries.text: You gain immunity to acid damage, increase all acid damage you deal by +2 damage dice, and gain vulnerability to cold damage.

entries.name: Got Your Back
entries.text: When standing within 15 ft. of an ally or attacking target, you can spend your reaction to redirect the attack onto yourself.

entries.name: Fortress
entries.text: The first instance of damage you take each turn is reduced by your level. This trait can be temporarily deactivated if this adversary is targeted by a B-Rank Chakra Dispel. The trait is deactivated until the end of this adversary's next turn.

entries.name: Iron Fist
entries.text: The first taijutsu or unarmed attack you make each turn adds +1d4 to the attack and damage rolls.
This adversary is immensely powerful. When it would cast a Futton Clan Hijutsu, it can double the jutsu's cost to increase its range or affected radius by 10 feet.

entries.name: Elite Defender
entries.text: This adversary gains a +3 bonus to armor damage reduction (added).

entries.name: Defender Passive 1
entries.text: At the beginning of each of your turns, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

entries.name: Defender Passive 2
entries.text: Allied creatures (excluding yourself) within 10 feet that the Defender can see gain 10 damage reduction against all damage types.

entries.name: Defender Action
entries.text: By spending 2 Tenacity dice and a reaction, it can Overguard. When it does, this adversary's allies gain one of the following benefits: • All of its allies' AC becomes equal to this adversary's until the end of the current turn. • All of its allies treat the result of all of their saves as this adversary's AC, until the beginning of this adversary's next turn. • All of its allies reduce damage they take from all sources by this adversary's AC, until the end of the next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Futton Jonin may make three attacks with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

The Futton Jonin takes one Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn, once each round, to either move, attack, cast a jutsu, or spend its Elite Action to gain an additional reaction. It regains spent Elite Actions at the beginning of each of its turns.
